scope: Manually reviewed image-level smoke labels of visible conditions, not enforcement decisions or a representative Pakistan benchmark.
label_definition: helmet_violation means clear visible bare-head evidence on a motorcycle; false does not certify every occupant or full compliance. Images with no motorcycle are negative controls.
limitations: Only five selected images; one image contains both cars and a motorcycle.
Ground truth is image-level. It does not measure object-level mAP, rider-level recall or per-vehicle localization accuracy.
No independently labeled readable Pakistan plates, car-interior seatbelts, or positive overload images are available here.
These images were already used during manual investigation; this is a smoke evaluation, not a held-out test set.
Foreign images test visual conditions only; Punjab jurisdiction is an explicit application setting, not an inferred location.
